messages.subject: Market Basket Analysis with RHadoop
parts:
Hi,

Could you please suggest if this code to do market basket analysis is acceptable to process in Hadoop cluster due to its logic and how to convert it as map and reduce function to use RHadoop to process the data? Thanks for any input you could provide...

#! /usr/bin/Rscript
require('arules')
f<-file("stdin")
txn = read.transactions(file=f, rm.duplicates= FALSE, format="single",sep=",",cols =c(1,2))
basket_rules <- apriori(txn,parameter = list(sup = 0.001, conf = 0.001,target="rules"))
inspect(basket_rules)

Stefen
